1.33 Browse and rate with the originals offline

Symptom. The originals are on a disk that is not attached, but you want to cull them in another application, such as Photo Mechanic, which needs camera metadata and a good-sized preview to be useful.

Prerequisites. Previews already exist: Lightroom Smart Previews, or a folder of regular preview JPEGs. Install diskproxy and its previews plugin; that book owns the configuration, the map-file format and the writable modes. Choose a ratings folder outside the source. Serve previews that Lightroom is not rebuilding at the same time: a served file that changes after the disk is built fails to read.

Mechanism. diskproxy presents a folder as a virtual disk without writing to the source. The previews plugin composes files in one of two ways:

  • Smart Previews as DNG stand-ins. Each Smart Preview is served as a DNG with the large preview JPEG added as an extra embedded preview; every original byte stays where it was. Browsers that show embedded previews see the large JPEG, and the stand-in carries the Smart Preview’s camera metadata.
  • Preview JPEGs with EXIF stubs. Each JPEG is served with camera, lens, exposure and capture metadata spliced in from a stub: an EXIF-only TIFF per photo, written from the phindex metadata records and stored in one SQLite file (metadata_store) rather than as hundreds of thousands of small files.

With a writable view, diskproxy accepts the application’s writes into a shadow file and the plugin keeps only ratings, labels, color classes and tagged flags, as one small XMP sidecar per photo in the ratings folder, with every change appended to JOURNAL.jsonl together with its previous value. Nothing reaches the source.

Verify. Check one file through the mounted volume before culling, for example exiftool -b -PreviewImage piped to wc -c, which should give the size of its preview JPEG, and confirm that the application shows the camera and capture time. After rating a few photos, confirm that their sidecars and journal lines exist after diskproxy stop, and that the source tree’s files are unchanged.

Undo. diskproxy stop unmounts the view and deletes the session’s written bytes after the final capture. Delete the ratings folder to discard the captured ratings. The source and Lightroom’s previews were never written.

Limits. A Smart Preview stand-in carries reduced raw data, not the original; exports from it are previews, not masters. Bringing captured ratings back into a Lightroom catalog must go through Lightroom’s own writer, and this cookbook has no qualified procedure for that yet. Do not write the catalog externally, and do not copy the captured sidecars beside the originals and read them with Read Metadata from Files: that replaces the catalog’s metadata from the sidecar, and a four-property sidecar is not the photo’s full state. Label names and color classes also differ between applications. Until a procedure is qualified, keep the sidecars and journal as the record of the culling.
